name: St. Joe River
blurb: Wild & Scenic water out of the Idaho panhandle. Shadowy St. Joe — cedar, cutthroat, and fewer people than the Coeur d'Alene.

sections.notes: Upper-ish Joe. Wood and cold water. Best in early summer before it drops.
sections.accessReview: The Avery and Calder endpoints are town-level placeholders. Specific public boating landings and legal approaches have not been confirmed for this listing. Review the actual accesses and matching river distance before planning a through float.

sections.notes: Flatter miles into the lake country. Watch for motorboats near town.
sections.accessReview: The Calder and St. Maries endpoints do not yet identify reviewed public boating landings. County-listed Scott Park and Cherry Bend are distinct facilities and must not be substituted without reviewing the trip and its river distance. Confirm the actual take-out and legal approach before planning this listing.
